abstract.para: &sbd; configuration is complex, involving many interrelated settings and timeouts. Even though &crmsh; helps to keep these settings aligned, upgrades or manual changes can sometimes introduce misconfigurations. The crm sbd configure show and crm sbd status commands automatically check the &sbd; configuration and list any issues. You can also check the configuration directly using the crm cluster health sbd command. This command lists issues with the &sbd; fence agent, configuration files, timeout settings, and more. It can also fix some of these issues automatically.

important.title: Cluster restart might be required
important.para: Certain fixes, such as timeout changes, require restarting the cluster services. The &sbd; health check with the --fix option restarts the cluster services automatically if required. If any non-fence resources are running, we recommend putting the cluster into maintenance mode before running the --fix script. This allows the services managed by the resources to keep running if the cluster restarts. However, the resources won't be highly available while in maintenance mode.
